description: The plot illustrates the loss of various models over the number of iterations, comparing different configurations of SepLLM and other models. The x-axis is labeled "#Iteration", has a linear scale, ranges from 0 to 140000, and has tick labels at intervals of 20000. The y-axis is labeled "Loss", has a linear scale, and ranges from 2.4 to 3.4 with tick labels at intervals of 0.1. The plot includes six lines representing different models: Vanilla (purple, solid), StrmLLM (n=64) (blue, solid), SepLLM (n=64) (orange, solid), SepLLM (n=64, H) (green, solid), SepLLM (n=64, H/T) (red, solid), and SepLLM (n=128) (dark blue, solid). All lines exhibit a decreasing trend in loss as the number of iterations increases, starting from around 3.3-3.4 at 0 iterations and decreasing to around 2.5-2.6 at 140000 iterations. The Vanilla model starts at approximately 3.3 and ends at around 2.5, while StrmLLM (n=64) starts at about 3.35 and ends at roughly 2.65. SepLLM (n=64), SepLLM (n=64, H), and SepLLM (n=64, H/T) have similar starting and ending values, around 3.3 and 2.5 respectively. SepLLM (n=128) starts at approximately 3.3 and ends at around 2.6. All lines show a sharp decline in loss during the initial iterations, followed by a gradual decrease as the number of iterations increases. Shaded regions around each line indicate variability or confidence intervals in the loss values.
